description:
Extra Colony Items
Add some colony items to Starsector.

Source code | Changelog and older versions

Required mods: MagicLib | LazyLib
Adding to an ongoing game: Yes, it's safe
Removing from an ongoing game: Destroy the items from the save first

What is this?

Just a mod that add colony items.

A total of 6 new colony items.
6 new bounties to get them.
4 bounties will be unlocked once the player reach level 8.
1 bounty will be unlocked once the player reach level 15, then 1 more will be unlocked once this bounty is successfully completed.

Some previews

Items preview

REDACTED

FAQ

FAQ
Loot pool dilution?
No, I didn't put them in normal loot table, you should only get the items from the bounties or if another mod spawn them.

Balance?
4 items were balanced around vanilla (at least that's the intention), so please report if you feel they are overtuned. The other 2 not so much, but I can tweak them if they feel too op (like the multiplier being too high).

AI?
Not used or involved at all in making this mod, unless you count some auto-complete thing. It's all human code slop and human scuffed image editing.

Changelog
1.0.3: Initial forum release.

Please send any feedback or bug reports here, I would really appreciate that.

Credits

Spoiler
Galatia Academy website for the mod template. I wouldn't even start without it.

Unofficial Starsector Chat for the resources that can be easily searched.

Alex and Fractal Softworks Team for making this game in the first place.
